Project Description

KTH Royal Institute of Technology, School of Industrial Engineering and Management, is seeking a motivated PhD student in intelligent robotics for production, with a focus on robot learning and AI-enabled automation. Third-cycle subject: Production engineering.

The research aims to develop intelligent robotic systems that combine learning-based methods and advanced algorithms to support flexible, adaptive and human-centred industrial production. The work includes reinforcement learning, foundation models, world models and dexterous manipulation with applications in real industrial environments.

The PhD student will collaborate closely with leading researchers, industrial partners, and international collaborators, contributing to both scientific advances and industrial innovation. The position is part of the Center of Excellence for Production Research (XPRES) and includes collaboration with leading European universities. The doctoral student will also join the new Production Systems and Automation unit at KTH, an inclusive and internationally oriented environment for research in intelligent robotics and automation for future production systems.

Supervision

Xi Wang and Sichao Liu are proposed to supervise the doctoral student. Decisions are made on admission.

Admission Requirements

To be admitted to postgraduate education, the applicant must have basic eligibility in accordance with either of the following:

  • Passed a second cycle degree (for example, a master's degree), or
  • Completed course requirements of at least 240 higher education credits, of which at least 60 second-cycle higher education credits, or
  • Acquired, in some other way within or outside the country, substantially equivalent knowledge.

In addition, there is a mandatory requirement for English equivalent to English B/6.

Selection Criteria

In order to succeed as a doctoral student at KTH you need to be goal oriented and persevering in your work. Candidates will be assessed on their ability to:

  • Independently pursue their work.
  • Collaborate with others.
  • Have a professional approach.
  • Analyze and work with complex issues.

After the qualification requirements, great emphasis will be placed on personal skills.

Employment Details

  • Only those admitted to postgraduate education may be employed as a doctoral student.
  • The total length of employment may not be longer than what corresponds to full-time doctoral education in four years' time.
  • An employed doctoral student can, to a limited extent (maximum 20%), perform certain tasks within their role, e.g. training and administration.
  • A new position as a doctoral student is for a maximum of one year, and then the employment may be renewed for a maximum of two years at a time.
  • As a doctoral student, you are entitled to a workplace with many employee benefits and monthly salary according to KTH's Doctoral student salary agreement.

Application Requirements

Applications must include:

  • Copies of diplomas and grades from previous university studies and certificates of fulfilled language requirements. Translations into English or Swedish if the original document is not issued in one of these languages. Copies of originals must be certified.
  • CV including relevant professional experience and knowledge.
  • Application letter with a brief description of why you want to pursue research studies, about what your academic interests are and how they relate to your previous studies and future goals (maximum 2 pages long).
  • Representative publications or technical reports. For longer documents, please provide a summary (abstract) and a web link to the full text.

Applications must be received at the last closing date at midnight, CET/CEST.

Application Portal

Apply for the position and admission through KTH's recruitment system (Varbi).

Important Notes

  • It may be the case that a position at KTH is classified as a security-sensitive role in accordance with the Protective Security Act (2018:585). If this applies, a security clearance will be conducted with the applicant's consent.
  • KTH firmly declines all contact with staffing and recruitment agencies and job ad salespersons.
  • In case of discrepancy between the Swedish original and the English translation, the Swedish version takes precedence.
